name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (fd2_chapter_<NN>_init). '23' is a meaningful chapter ID (chapters 01-30 are valid domain IDs), not an address residue; the function address 0x336a0 does not appear in the name. xref-confirmed entry in the chapter init handler dispatch table at 0x51dc9 (first LE pointer there = a0 36 03 00 = 0x000336a0).
purpose: Chapter 23 (向天空之旅) init/prologue handler: a cinematic 'reassemble the party' opener built around a screen-wide spell, dispatched (not directly called) via the chapter init handler table.
logic_summary: After the Watcom __CHK(0x2C) frame-size probe, re-inits battle state, then runs two constant-bound loops over the 16 active party slots: (1) pre-spell mark-dead loop fd2_mark_char_as_dead(i) for i=0..0xF clears every active slot's HP; (2) pans cursor/window to (0xE,0x20) and casts fd2_cast_screen_wide_spell_with_fade(cursor_screen_x+6, cursor_screen_y+5, 10, 8) (epicenter at cursor +6/+5 tiles, start radius 10, +8 per frame); (3) post-spell revive filter for i=0..0xF: any unit with hp_current!=0 gets flags=0 and sprite_state[1]=2 (face north). Then composites a frame, restores palette, and plays five dialog pages (0..4) chained with three cutscenes (event ids 0x44/0x45/0x46) and a portrait-load palette-flash sequence (saturate add 0xFF then restore add 0, bracketed by composite-frame redraws and timed delays). data_fd2_battle_anim_phase is reset to 0 once, after the page-3 dialog only. Two further fixed writes set slot 0x10 and slot 0x11 sprite_state[1]=2. Ends with fd2_clear_all_chars_facing() then fd2_pan_cursor_to_char(0). No char init (party carries over from previous chapter). In the binary the final pan_cursor_to_char(0) is a tail-JMP into fd2_chapter_15_init's shared epilogue (0x33594); the source is the functionally-equivalent Layer-2 straight-line reconstruction.

returns.semantics: No return value; pure side-effect cinematic/state-setup routine.

notes: Source comment block (chinit.c lines 1196-1248) is already a refined, accurate, ASCII-clean conclusion that matches the decompilation and KB ground truth (chapter title 向天空之旅; post-action win=destroy 機甲隊長 char[0x12], lose=any of chars[0,1,0x10,0x11] dead = 索爾/希爾法/卡里斯/羅德曼); kept as-is, chinit.c NOT edited. Ghidra plate is a compact body-pseudocode dump semantically consistent with the source (same calls/loops/constants; uses Ghidra struct field names wHP_current/bFlags/pSprite_state vs source hp_current/flags/sprite_state -- same fields, no contradiction), so plate left untouched.
